unit: per kg (carcase or live weight) or per head
note: Meat & Livestock Australia NLRS saleyard indicators: weighted average auction prices for the trading day, in Australian dollars (converted from MLA's cents per kg); n is the number of animals sold. MLA publishes some indicators a day or two late; their newest trading day is kept: National Light Lamb (2026-10-30), National Trade Lamb (2026-10-30), National Heavy Lamb (2026-10-30), National Merino Lamb (2026-10-30), National Restocker Lamb (2026-10-30), National Mutton (2026-10-30), Online Young Cattle (2026-10-31), Online Lamb (2026-10-31), Online Sheep (2026-10-31).
